name: Git Push Review Reminder
description: Before executing shell commands that involve git push, remind to review changes first

then.prompt: If this shell command involves 'git push', ensure you have: 1) Reviewed the diff with git diff, 2) Confirmed all tests pass, 3) Verified no console.log or hardcoded secrets in the diff, 4) Used a feature branch (not main/master). If the command is not git-related, proceed normally.
